description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 24.08.2020 to 30.08.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs calculations will be performed. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Director General of Customs is incidental to the regulatory function being performed, not the primary focus of the gazette.
